 SpiceJet shares rally 30% in 6 days even as flight cancellations leave passengers stranded at airports. What’s boosting the stock?
 SECTIONS SpiceJet shares rally 30% in 6 days even as flight cancellations leave passengers stranded at airports. What’s boosting the stock? By Debaroti Adhikary , ETMarkets.com Last Updated: Nov 18, 2026, 12:54:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis SpiceJet shares have rallied around 30% in six sessions, hitting the upper circuit for five consecutive days despite flight cancellations and operational disruptions. Expectations of a fresh capital raise and easing oil prices have boosted investor sentiment.
 ETMarkets.com SpiceJet shares defy operational turbulence as investors bet on a potential fundraise.
 Shares of SpiceJet have rallied around 30% in just six days, shrugging off operational challenges that have led to several flight cancellations and left passengers stranded at multiple airports across the country.
 SpiceJet shares hit the 5% upper circuit at Rs 9.97 apiece on BSE on Wednesday. Notably, the stock hit the upper circuit for the fifth consecutive session today. The sharp gains over six straight days added around Rs 350 crore to the company’s market capitalisation, pulling it up to Rs 1,522 crore.
 Why are SpiceJet shares rallying despite operational challenges? 
The sharp surge in SpiceJet comes as its board is set to consider and approve a proposal to raise fresh capital at its meeting scheduled for today, boosting investor sentiment even as the company faces operational challenges.
 Also read | SpiceJet board to meet on November 18 to consider fresh capital raising proposal 
In an exchange filing released on Friday, SpiceJet said its board would consider and approve the fundraising proposal at its meeting on Wednesday. The proposed fundraise could involve the issuance of equity shares, preference shares, debt securities or other permissible instruments through a preferential issue, qualified institutional placement (QIP) or any other mode. Easing oil prices further supported the rally.
 Live Events
 SpiceJet runs into operational challenges 
The fundraising plan sparked a sharp rise in SpiceJet’s share price even as the company continued to face operational challenges. The airline’s delays and operational challenges led to hundreds of passengers being stranded at Mumbai Airport. Several videos surfaced on social media, showing chaos at the airport.
 Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport last week cautioned passengers about possible flight disruptions involving the airline, advising travellers to check their flight status directly with the carrier before proceeding with their travel plans.
 Meanwhile, SpiceJet recently told The Economic Times that it is taking a “calibrated approach” to rebuild its capacity and strengthen its network, with improving aircraft availability and operational reliability among its immediate priorities. The airline’s capacity rebuilding efforts come against the backdrop of earlier reports of flight delays and cancellations, as well as questions over its operational capacity.
 Also read | SpiceJet reveals its comeback game plan as a turbulent battle to reclaim lost ground unfolds 
“Our immediate priority is to strengthen operational stability and build greater resilience into our schedules. We are working on improving aircraft availability, optimising resources and ensuring that operational issues are addressed as quickly as possible,” a SpiceJet spokesperson said.
 SpiceJet share price 
SpiceJet shares jumped 27% in five days and 22% in the past one month. The stock has, however, fallen 18% in the past six months and 67% in 2026 so far.
In the longer term, the stock has plunged 73% over the past one year and 87% over five years.
